about.text: The small foil-wrapped processed cheese of the Soviet Union and Russia. The best known, Druzhba, was developed in 1960 at Moscow's Karat plant and is still made to the same recipe.

how.text: Soviet and Russian processed cheese is made by melting rennet cheeses with tvorog, butter and melting salts at 75–95 °C into a homogeneous mass, sold as dense sliceable blocks such as the 'Druzhba' foil-wrapped bar or as soft spreadable pastes.
